allocation_intro: Your investment pool over time, compared with your current targets.
allocation_scope_help: This total covers only the accounts in your investment pool. Total net worth can also include college savings, reserved funds, family loans and other assets outside this pool.
allocation_scope_suggested: Suggested scope: review the included accounts and save your investment pool. Deposits are included; reserved accounts can be excluded.
allocation_no_targets: No targets saved yet. Actual allocation is shown independently.
allocation_empty_pool: No accounts in this investment pool.
allocation_chart_help: Each band is an instrument’s share of the fully valued pool. Cash weight can change without a cash movement. Samples:
allocation_chart_accessible: Stacked actual allocation. Use the date and instrument controls and the allocation table for exact values.
allocation_gaps: Gaps indicate missing prices or exchange rates, signed holdings, or non-positive totals. Those dates remain inspectable in the table.
allocation_current_help: Every date is compared with the current targets and current pool membership. Saved changes can be inspected below; they do not select historical targets. Saving a returns run does not save this chart or these targets.
allocation_signed: This date contains negative holdings. Use the signed table; a conventional 100% stack would misrepresent it.
allocation_stale: Some samples use prices or exchange rates from earlier dates within the displayed valuation window.
allocation_currency_help: Currency allocation uses instrument quote currencies and each cash balance’s currency. It does not measure underlying geographic or economic currency exposure.
allocation_history_help: These timestamps show when changes were saved, not when targets became effective. Previous and new targets and the affected pool are retained.
allocation_edit_help: Choose exact accounts for your investment pool; selecting a parent does not automatically select its children. Include deposit accounts and exclude reserved accounts as needed. Targets must total 100%. Percentages accept up to four decimal places in your input language.
allocation_target_validation: Enter valid nonnegative percentages, with at most four decimal places, totalling exactly 100%. Existing targets cannot be cleared accidentally.
allocation_valuation_window: Each sample uses recorded prices and exchange rates on or before its date, no more than {days} days old.
allocation_returns_scope: Returns uses its own account selection. Allocation uses your saved Investment pool; this link carries only the dates and reporting currency.
allocation_negative_cash: Negative account cash balances: {value}. This subtotal is already included in net cash and the pool total.
